eyebrow: Azure DBA Capstone · Advanced · Chapter 2, Lesson 6
subtitle: One command, turned into Overlook's real dev environment

code:
az deployment group create \
  --resource-group OverlookRG \
  --template-file main.bicep \
  --parameters environmentName=dev \
               sqlServerName=overlook-sql-dev \
               sqlDatabaseName=OverlookDB \
               sqlAdminLogin=overlookadmin \
               sqlAdminPassword=$SQL_ADMIN_PASSWORD
caption: The password comes from an environment variable — never typed in plain text, never committed.

subtitle: Locking this new environment down before real patient data lands in it
